issue.title: Bug: Incorrect onie loading for 6-asic kvm image

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

When I build multi-asic kvm image, I found the onie for 6-asic is wrong which used 4-asic onie. I checked the code, found there is a mistake of onie_recovery_kvm_6asic_image in slave.mk
'''
export onie_recovery_image="$(FILES_PATH)/$(ONIE_RECOVERY_IMAGE)"
export onie_recovery_kvm_4asic_image="$(FILES_PATH)/$(ONIE_RECOVERY_KVM_4ASIC_IMAGE)"
export onie_recovery_kvm_6asic_image="$(FILES_PATH)/$(ONIE_RECOVERY_KVM_4ASIC_IMAGE)"
'''

### Steps to Reproduce

make BUILD_MULTIASIC_KVM=y target/sonic-vs.img.gz

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

6-asic kvm image should install 6-asic onie, not 4-asic onie.
